name: cast
author: Realmforge
description: The cast animation of every cast-time and channelled spell (RLM-435), from spike 4 (ADR 0020): both arms rise forward and pulse while casting. In first person the hands meet below the crosshair with a gap between them (RLM-89): pitch -1.60 and yaw 0.22 at the hold, -1.85 and 0.07 at the pulse. Animates only the arms' rotations, so lower layers (Better Combat's idle poses, walking) show through everywhere else.
